mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces discount rates for equity valuation models, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs fall across the corporate sector.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and suppresses earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), accelerating job growth (PAYEMS rising > 0.5% MoM) signals sustained labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS rises > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment rate indicates tightening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 102 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and earnings visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 102, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic weakness across manufacturing and construction sectors, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days through reduced earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high retail sales regimes (RSAFS > 680000), rising housing starts (HOUST rising > 0.5% MoM) signals sustained consumer confidence that accelerates corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 680000 and HOUST rises > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
